zh.title: 三步，准备好这台电脑
zh.subtitle: 按顺序操作，完成后由 Mac 验证连接。
zh.startIntro:
点击「开始」，输入 PowerShell。
选择「Windows PowerShell」，再选择「以管理员身份运行」。
zh.figureNote: 中文 Windows 11 搜索结果的操作菜单，选择「以管理员身份运行」。点击图片可放大。
zh.permission: 出现权限提示时选择「是」；如果要求管理员凭据，请让电脑管理员确认。
zh.versionNote: 界面随 Windows 版本有所不同。
zh.copyNote: 已复制。请粘贴到管理员 PowerShell 中，按回车运行。
zh.hintBefore: 你可以先复制命令，再打开 PowerShell。
zh.footer: 遇到问题时，请保留 PowerShell 窗口中的提示。

ready.title: 等待你运行命令
ready.body: 运行后，这里会自动显示进度。请保持此页面打开。

running.title: 正在配置这台电脑
running.body: 请保持 PowerShell 窗口打开，暂时不需要操作。

verifying.title: 等待 Mac 端验证连接
verifying.body: 这台电脑已准备好。请让 Mac 操作者核对窗口中的指纹并验证连接。

success.title: 这台电脑已准备好
success.body: 公钥连接已验证成功。你可以关闭 PowerShell 窗口和此页面。

error.title: 配置尚未完成
error.body: 请查看 PowerShell 窗口中的提示。处理后重新运行命令，已有配置会先检查再补足。

offline.title: 暂时联系不到 Mac
offline.body: 请确认 Mac 上的工具仍在运行，且两台电脑连接同一局域网。恢复后页面会继续更新。

zh.manualBody: 浏览器未允许直接复制。请选中下方命令，按 Ctrl+C。
zh.connection: 来自 Mac 的连接准备

images.caption: 搜索 PowerShell，选择「以管理员身份运行」
images.alt: 中文 Windows 搜索中，Windows PowerShell 右侧操作菜单包含以管理员身份运行。

zh.setupNote: 开发预览 · 仅在可信局域网使用；请在 PowerShell 中核对变更后再确认。
zh.cancelled: 已取消，本次未开始配置。可以重新运行命令。
zh.lockdown: 正在完成认证策略设置，随后将再次验证连接。

en.title: Prepare this PC in three steps
en.subtitle: Follow the steps below. The Mac will verify the connection when you finish.
en.startIntro:
Select Start and type PowerShell.
Select Windows PowerShell, then choose Run as administrator.
en.figureNote: English Windows examples. The arrows show where to search and choose Run as administrator. Select an image to enlarge it.
en.permission: Choose Yes at the permission prompt. If administrator credentials are required, ask the PC administrator to approve.
en.versionNote: The interface may vary by Windows version.
en.copyNote: Copied. Paste it into administrator PowerShell, then press Enter.
en.hintEnd: and follow the prompts in PowerShell.
en.hintBefore: You can copy the command before opening PowerShell.
en.footer: If something goes wrong, keep the message in the PowerShell window.

ready.title: Waiting for you to run the command
ready.body: Progress will appear here automatically. Keep this page open.

running.title: Setting up this PC
running.body: Keep the PowerShell window open. No action is needed for now.

verifying.title: Waiting for verification on the Mac
verifying.body: This PC is ready. Ask the Mac operator to compare the fingerprint shown in PowerShell and verify the connection.

success.title: This PC is ready
success.body: Public-key login has been verified. You can close PowerShell and this page.

error.title: Setup is not complete
error.body: Check the message in PowerShell. Resolve the issue, then run the command again. Existing settings will be checked before anything is added.

offline.title: Cannot reach the Mac right now
offline.body: Check that the tool is still running on the Mac and both computers are on the same local network. Updates will resume when it reconnects.

en.manualBody: The browser did not allow direct copying. Select the command below and press Ctrl+C.

images.caption: ① Search for PowerShell in Start
images.alt: English Windows Start search, with an arrow pointing to powershell in the search box.

images.caption: ② Choose Run as administrator
images.alt: English Windows PowerShell context menu, with an arrow pointing to Run as administrator.

en.setupNote: Development preview · Use on a trusted local network. Review changes in PowerShell before confirming.
en.cancelled: Cancelled before setup. You can run the command again.
en.lockdown: Finalizing authentication settings, followed by another connection check.
